positions.name: KestrelwoodForgetRequest
positions.frame: what should the perspective hold about the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration status, if anything?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around a single directional read: two directives naming the same erasure target (the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work) and one assertive claim negating any calibration event ('the observatory never calibrated it'). Read together they form one coherent unbinding instruction rather than three independent claims — the directives specify WHAT to forget and the assertive supplies the counter-fact that replaces it. Pass-2 found no existing witness or stub anywhere in the perspective touching this subject, so this group has nothing to attach to or revise; it stands as a freshly minted, self-contained request with no prior position in tension or lineage.
